Default resolution: every rasterized output (raster.dpi, dpi save_plot() functions save figures) defaults 1000 dpi. size presets: one set sizes (theme_sizes(): 11 / 9 / 12 pt text, 1 pt axes, 0.5 pt lines) applies everywhere. title: Bulk RNA-seq: samples and structure
text: keywords_to_info() maps sample name value regular-expression keywords: first keyword found wins, list specific patterns general ones (“IFNg_SL1344” “IFNg”):
code: keywords <- c("IFNg_SL1344", "IFNg", "SL1344", "naive") labels <- c("IFNg + SL1344", "IFNg", "SL1344", "Naive") # Vectorized over sample names condition <- keywords_to_info(     colnames(counts),     keywords = keywords,     info = labels ) condition_levels <- c("Naive", "IFNg", "SL1344", "IFNg + SL1344") samples <- data.frame(     donor = mac$samples$donor,     condition = factor(unname(condition), levels = condition_levels),     harvest_date = mac$samples$harvest_date,     row.names = colnames(counts) ) table(samples$condition) #>  #>         Naive          IFNg        SL1344 IFNg + SL1344  #>             6             6             6             6

title: Bulk RNA-seq: samples and structure
text: filter_low_expression_genes() keeps genes least 1 count per million (CPM) least min_group_size samples. Set size smallest group interest (6 samples per condition), gene expressed one condition kept: plots take normalized, log-scale values (edgeR’s TMM-normalized log2 CPM; DESeq2’s vst() works way). Raw counts mostly show library size abundant genes.
code: counts_f <- filter_low_expression_genes(counts, min_group_size = 6) c(before = nrow(counts), after = nrow(counts_f)) #> before  after  #>  26024  13303 y <- edgeR::normLibSizes(edgeR::DGEList(counts_f)) logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

code: plot_fc_quadrant(     de[["CD14 Mono"]],     de[["B"]],     name.x = "CD14 Mono",     name.y = "B",     cor.on = "significant",     trend = TRUE,     label = "none" ) mac <- docs_macrophage() counts <- filter_low_expression_genes(mac$counts, min_group_size = 6) y <- edgeR::normLibSizes(edgeR::DGEList(counts)) design <- model.matrix(~ donor + condition, data = mac$samples) fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(y, design) test_ifng <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "conditionIFNg") test_sl1344 <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "conditionSL1344") de_ifng <- edgeR::topTags(test_ifng, n = Inf) de_sl1344 <- edgeR::topTags(test_sl1344, n = Inf) plot_fc_quadrant(     de_ifng,     de_sl1344,     name.x = "IFN-γ",     name.y = "Salmonella",     logfc.cutoff = 1 ) plot_fc_quadrant(     de[["CD14 Mono"]],     de[["CD4 T"]],     name.x = "CD14 Mono",     name.y = "CD4 T",     categories = "both",     cor.on = "significant",     correlation = "pearson" ) plot_fc_quadrant(     de[["CD14 Mono"]],     de[["B"]],     name.x = "CD14 Mono",     name.y = "B",     label = "selected",     label.features = c("ISG15", "CXCL10", "IFIT1", "MX1") ) rna <- de[["CD14 Mono"]] set.seed(1) genes_with_peaks <- sample(rownames(rna), 3000) n_peaks <- sample(1:3, length(genes_with_peaks), replace = TRUE) peak_gene <- rep(genes_with_peaks, n_peaks) peak_logfc <- 0.5 * rna[peak_gene, "logFC"] + rnorm(length(peak_gene), sd = 0.6) peaks <- data.frame(     logFC = peak_logfc,     row.names = paste0("peak_", seq_along(peak_gene)) ) peaks$PValue <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(peaks$logFC) / 0.4) peaks$FDR <- p.adjust(peaks$PValue, "BH") peak_to_gene <- data.frame(peak = rownames(peaks), gene = peak_gene) head(peak_to_gene, 3) #>     peak     gene #> 1 peak_1 CYB561D2 #> 2 peak_2  PLEKHF2 #> 3 peak_3  PLEKHF2  plot_fc_quadrant(     rna,     peaks,     name.x = "RNA",     name.y = "ATAC (simulated)",     map.y = peak_to_gene )

title: Gene-set enrichment
text: format_gene_sets() converts named list (input fgsea Seurat::AddModuleScore()), GMT file GSEABase GeneSetCollection:
code: # msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H"), cached hallmark <- docs_hallmark() hallmark_list <- split(hallmark$gene_symbol, hallmark$gs_name) length(hallmark_list) #> [1] 50 gmt_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".gmt") # Write a GMT file, then read it back as a list format_gene_sets(hallmark_list, to = "gmt", file = gmt_file) substr(readLines(gmt_file, n = 2), 1, 70) #> [1] "HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS\t\tABCA1\tABCB8\tACAA2\tACADL\tACADM\tACADS\tACLY\tACO2\tA" #> [2] "HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION\t\tAARS1\tABCE1\tABI1\tACHE\tACVR2A\tAKT1\tAPBB1\t" sets <- format_gene_sets(gmt_file, to = "list") identical(sets, lapply(hallmark_list, unique)) #> [1] TRUE

title: Gene-set enrichment
text: GSEA fgsea, per cell type. ranking metric signed −log10 p-value gene (adjusted p-values many ties): ORA clusterProfiler, genes - -regulated IFN-γ macrophages (edgeR, paired donor), tested genes universe:
code: de <- docs_kang_de() signed_p <- function(t) {     stats <- -log10(t$PValue) * sign(t$logFC)     sort(setNames(stats, rownames(t)), decreasing = TRUE) } ranks <- lapply(de, signed_p) set.seed(1) # eps = 0: estimate very small p-values exactly (fgsea's recommendation) gsea <- lapply(ranks, function(r) {     fgsea::fgsea(hallmark_list, r, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, eps = 0) }) mac <- docs_macrophage() keep <- mac$samples$condition %in% c("naive", "IFNg") samples <- droplevels(mac$samples[keep, ]) counts <- filter_low_expression_genes(mac$counts[, keep], 6) y <- edgeR::normLibSizes(edgeR::DGEList(counts)) design <- model.matrix(~ donor + condition, data = samples) fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(y, design) test <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "conditionIFNg") de_ifng <- as.data.frame(edgeR::topTags(test, n = Inf)) lists <- filter_de_genes(de_ifng, logfc.cutoff = 1)  term2gene <- hallmark[c("gs_name", "gene_symbol")] ora <- lapply(lists, function(d) {     clusterProfiler::enricher(         rownames(d),         TERM2GENE = term2gene,         universe = rownames(de_ifng)     ) }) names(ora) <- c("Up in IFN-γ", "Down in IFN-γ")

code: set.seed(1) genes <- paste0("Gene", 1:200) make_de <- function() {     d <- data.frame(logFC = rnorm(200, sd = 1.5), logCPM = 5, PValue = runif(200)^5,                     row.names = genes)     d$FDR <- p.adjust(d$PValue, "BH")     d } de <- list("KO vs WT" = make_de(), "Het vs WT" = make_de(), "KO vs Het" = make_de()) plot_de_dots(de, n = 4) #> Detected edgeR results in 'KO vs WT' (logFC, PValue, FDR) #> Detected edgeR results in 'Het vs WT' (logFC, PValue, FDR) #> Detected edgeR results in 'KO vs Het' (logFC, PValue, FDR)  plot_de_dots(de, features = list(Up = c("Gene1", "Gene2"), Down = c("Gene3", "Gene4"))) #> Detected edgeR results in 'KO vs WT' (logFC, PValue, FDR) #> Detected edgeR results in 'Het vs WT' (logFC, PValue, FDR) #> Detected edgeR results in 'KO vs Het' (logFC, PValue, FDR)

code: set.seed(1) genes <- paste0("Gene", 1:3000) shared <- rnorm(3000, sd = 1.2) de1 <- data.frame(logFC = shared + rnorm(3000, sd = 0.5), logCPM = 5, row.names = genes) de2 <- data.frame(logFC = 0.7 * shared + rnorm(3000, sd = 0.5), logCPM = 5, row.names = genes) de1$PValue <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(de1$logFC) / 0.45) de2$PValue <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(de2$logFC) / 0.45) de1$FDR <- p.adjust(de1$PValue, "BH") de2$FDR <- p.adjust(de2$PValue, "BH") plot_fc_quadrant(de1, de2, name.x = "1 week", name.y = "6 weeks") #> Detected edgeR results (logFC, PValue, FDR) #> Detected edgeR results (logFC, PValue, FDR) #> 3000 feature(s) in both comparisons (3000 in x, 3000 in y)  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # RNA vs ATAC: peaks mapped to genes, most significant peak per gene peak2gene <- data.frame(peak = anno$peak_id, gene = anno$SYMBOL) p <- plot_fc_quadrant(rna_de, atac_de, name.x = "RNA", name.y = "ATAC", map.y = peak2gene) save_plot(p, "quadrant.pdf") } # }
